specs.label: Right-click ButMode block opens the Mouse Config pop-up
specs.note: The `.pymenu` popup (PopupMenu.tsx) is rendered from the `pymolMenu` store singleton. Its ONLY in-app opener is ButModeBlock.cycleMode, which calls pymolMenu.openAt(...) when event.button===2 on the mouse-mode line (onMouseDown). Expect a `.pymenu` popup titled 'Mouse Config' with the header `.pymenu__head`. BLOCKED: the deterministic driver's `click` primitive issues a left-button click only and cannot synthesize the right-button mousedown this opener requires.

specs.label: Pop-up renders its title as a non-clickable header row
specs.note:
openAt(..., title='Mouse Config') renders `
Mouse Config
` (PopupMenu.tsx:71). It is not a button and must not be a menuitem. BLOCKED: opening the popup needs a right-click gesture the driver cannot produce.

specs.label: Code-0 row renders as a non-clickable separator bar
specs.note: The mouse_config payload's 6th entry is {kind:0} which PopupMenu renders as `<div class='pymenu__sep'>` (PopupMenu.tsx:74), NOT a button — the pop-up must contain exactly 8 `.pymenu__item` buttons and one `.pymenu__sep`. BLOCKED: popup only opens on right-click.

specs.label: Leaf '3-Button Motions' runs cmd.config_mouse("three_button_motions")
specs.note: Choosing a kind-1 leaf closes the popup and sends its command string verbatim through session.run (PopupMenu.tsx:89-94, dispatchLeaf fallback). Command: cmd.config_mouse("three_button_motions"). Expect the console to echo it and the popup to disappear. BLOCKED: reaching the leaf requires first right-clicking to open the popup.

specs.label: Leaf '3-Button Editing' runs cmd.config_mouse("three_button_editing")
specs.note: Second mouse_config leaf. Command: cmd.config_mouse("three_button_editing"). Should echo and close the popup. BLOCKED: popup opens only on right-click.

specs.label: Leaf '3-Button Viewing' runs cmd.mouse("three_button_viewing")
specs.note: Third leaf — note it calls cmd.mouse (jump to an out-of-ring mode), NOT config_mouse (mouseConfig.ts:117). Command: cmd.mouse("three_button_viewing"). BLOCKED: popup opens only on right-click.

specs.label: Leaf '3-Button Lights' runs cmd.mouse("three_button_lights")
specs.note: Fourth leaf, also a cmd.mouse jump. Command: cmd.mouse("three_button_lights"). BLOCKED: popup opens only on right-click.

specs.label: Leaf '3-Button All Modes' runs cmd.config_mouse("three_button_all_modes")
specs.note: Fifth leaf (last before the separator). Command: cmd.config_mouse("three_button_all_modes") — this is the exact leaf asserted verbatim by PopupMenu.dom.test.tsx:88. BLOCKED: popup opens only on right-click.

specs.label: Leaf '2-Button Editing' runs cmd.config_mouse("two_button_editing")
specs.note: Sixth clickable leaf (first after the separator; it is button nth=5 because the separator is not a button). Command: cmd.config_mouse("two_button_editing"). BLOCKED: popup opens only on right-click.

specs.label: Leaf '2-Button Viewing' runs cmd.config_mouse("two_button_viewing")
specs.note: Seventh clickable leaf. Command: cmd.config_mouse("two_button_viewing"). BLOCKED: popup opens only on right-click.

specs.label: Leaf '2-Button Lights' runs cmd.mouse("two_button_lights")
specs.note: Eighth and last clickable leaf, a cmd.mouse jump. Command: cmd.mouse("two_button_lights"). BLOCKED: popup opens only on right-click.

specs.label: Choosing any leaf dismisses the pop-up
specs.note: Every leaf onClick calls pymolMenu.close() before dispatch (PopupMenu.tsx:90), so the popup must vanish after a choice regardless of which leaf. BLOCKED: popup opens only on right-click.

specs.label: Escape dismisses the open pop-up
specs.note: A window-level capture-phase keydown handler closes on Escape and stops propagation so the keyboard service never sees it as a PyMOL keystroke (PopupMenu.tsx:51-56). Expect `.pymenu` to disappear. BLOCKED: the popup must first be opened by a right-click gesture the driver cannot synthesize.

specs.label: Mousedown outside the pop-up dismisses it
specs.note: A window-level capture-phase mousedown handler closes the popup when the target is null or not contained by the popup element (PopupMenu.tsx:45-49). Clicking elsewhere (e.g. the command line) should hide `.pymenu`. BLOCKED: popup opens only on right-click.

specs.label: Opening a second pop-up replaces the first (exactly one at a time)
specs.note: pymolMenu is a module singleton modelling PyMOL's single CPopUp; a second openAt replaces the first and the epoch bump forces a re-render even at the same point (menuStore.ts:55-63, PopupMenu.dom.test.tsx:115). Expect never more than one `.pymenu` in the DOM. BLOCKED: each open requires a right-click gesture.

specs.label: Pop-up is clamped inside the viewport after it lays out
specs.note: useLayoutEffect measures the popup and clamps left/top to keep it >=4px inside the window edges (PopupMenu.tsx:32-41), so a click near the right/bottom edge must not overflow off-screen. Purely visual placement — needs an eyeball. BLOCKED: popup opens only on right-click.

specs.label: Registered leaf hook intercepts cmd.volume_panel(...) instead of running it in the engine
specs.note: MenuHost mounts installVolumeMenuBridge which registerLeafHook('volume-panel', ...) (menuBridge.ts:241); dispatchLeaf tries hooks before the engine fallback and a claiming hook stops the command reaching session.run (leafHooks.ts:77-95). The intercepted 'cmd.volume_panel(<sele>)' leaf only appears in a volume object's C>volume menu (objects-panel RowMenu, a second dispatch site), so exercising it needs a loaded volume object AND a right-click. Expect the React volume editor to open rather than a 'volume_panel' console echo. BLOCKED: needs a volume object and a right-click gesture; not reproducible in local-backend via the driver.

specs.label: A throwing leaf hook is contained and the command still reaches the engine
specs.note: dispatchLeaf wraps each hook in try/catch and treats a throw as 'not handled', so one broken hook cannot make every PyMOL menu inert (leafHooks.ts:83-90). Behavioural guarantee verified by unit intent; observable only when a hook is registered and a leaf is chosen. BLOCKED: requires opening the popup (right-click) plus a fault-injected hook not present in the running app.
